prompt:
On a fresh morning at a modern subway station, natural sunlight filters through the metal bars of the escalator, creating soft highlights and shadows on the skin. A young girl steps onto the escalator, her body leaning slightly back, head turned to look over her left shoulder as if suddenly recognizing someone or remembering something.
Character:
A Japanese girl about 20 years old, extremely fair porcelain-smooth skin without any freckles or blemishes, shoulder-length natural black-brown hair slightly tousled by the wind, with hair covering the forehead and cheeks. Large round eyes, wearing natural brown contact lenses, a clear gaze. Delicate face, high nose, thin lips slightly parted.
Outfit:
Thin dark blue camisole with a small floral pattern, completely open back with two soft bows tied in the middle. Old light blue denim shorts, frayed edges, moderately low waist. When standing tilted and slightly leaning forward, a small part of thin lace panties in a random color (cream white or light pink) is visible between the thighs, just enough to see in the center, not too revealing.
Context:
A shiny metal escalator at a Skytrain station, with glass walls and stainless steel handrails on both sides. Clear Japanese signs above: 「スカイトレイン駅」 and 「ターミナルへ乗り換え」 with direction arrows. Natural morning light from above creates a light HDR effect on skin and fabric.
Expression (90% Japanese style):
Gaze slightly tilted, eyelids half-closed, lips slightly parted as if smiling lightly but also showing a bit of confusion, worry mixed with curiosity—a diverse expression giving an everyday Japanese feel: both happy and shy, gentle happiness mixed with a bit of unease when being seen.
Image Style:
Documentary Lifestyle Photography • Camera iPhone 17 • Natural Morning Light • Everyday Slice of Life • Realistic Skin Texture • Phone Camera HDR • Authentic Human Expression • Casual Station Moment • Ultra Photorealistic • No AI Face • Close-up 9:16
The entire frame is always a close-up from the waist up, focusing on the back, shoulders, neck, and side face, maintaining a real, natural feel like an everyday moment caught quickly on a phone.

promptZh:
在一个清新的早晨，现代地铁站内，自然阳光透过自动扶梯的金属栅栏洒下，在皮肤上形成柔和的高光与阴影。一位年轻女孩踏上扶梯，身体微微后倾，头向左肩后转，仿佛突然认出了某人或想起了什么。
角色：
一位 20 岁左右的日本女孩，皮肤白皙光滑如瓷，无雀斑或瑕疵，自然的黑棕色齐肩发被风吹得略显凌乱，前额发丝遮住额头和双颊。大圆眼，佩戴自然棕色美瞳，目光清澈。五官精致，高鼻梁，薄唇微张。
服装：
一件带有小碎花图案的深蓝黑色吊带衫，露背设计，背部中间有两条柔软的丝带系带。复古浅蓝色毛边牛仔短裤，中低腰设计。侧身微躬时，腰间隐约可见一小截随机颜色（奶油白或浅粉色）的蕾丝内衣边，尺度适中。
场景：
轻轨站内闪亮的金属自动扶梯，两侧是玻璃墙和不锈钢扶手。背景中有清晰的日文标识：「スカイトレイン駅」（轻轨站）和「ターミナルへ乗り換え」（换乘航站楼）以及方向箭头。清晨的自然光从上方照射，在皮肤和织物上营造出轻微的 HDR 效果。
表情（90% 日系风格）：
微微倾斜的目光，眼睑半开半合，嘴唇微张，仿佛在轻笑，又带着一丝困惑、忧虑与好奇交织的神情——这是一种充满日本日常生活感的多元表情：既有快乐和羞涩，也有被注视时那种温柔的幸福感中夹杂的一点点不安。
图像风格：
纪实生活摄影 • iPhone 17 拍摄 • 清晨自然光 • 日常生活片段 • 写实皮肤纹理 • 手机摄影 HDR • 真实的人类表情 • 车站随拍 • 超写实 • 非 AI 脸 • 特写 9:16
整个画面始终保持腰部以上的特写镜头，聚焦于背部、肩膀、颈部和侧脸轮廓，保留手机随手抓拍日常瞬间的真实自然感。
